scope: Source-audited review of 20 published European landscape identities; 7 attributable financing, equity, grant and ownership events for 7 companies approved pending rollback rehearsal.

sources.title: JR Holding reports subscription for 393,050 newly issued Prometheus Series G shares
Prometheus identifies JR Holding as the lead Polish investor supporting development and production

rounds.note_en: JR Holding reported subscribing for 393,050 newly issued Series G shares. A separate conditional purchase of 98,263 existing shares from a shareholder is not counted as issuer financing; no monetary subscription amount was disclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The primary share subscription is recorded without inventing its price. The separate secondary purchase remains outside funding totals.

sources.title: Unimot signs conditional agreement to acquire 40% of PZL Defence for PLN400,000

rounds.note_en: The agreement provides for Unimot to acquire 40% after PZL Defence's court registration. The disclosed PLN400,000 is a conditional stake-purchase consideration and is not represented as primary issuer proceeds.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The signed ownership transaction is recorded as an investment disclosure. Closing has not been inferred from the announcement.

sources.title: Polish ministry agreement allocates PLN26.6m to Leonardo PZL-Swidnik
Polish Ministry of Finance register confirms the 2 April 2026 investment agreement

investors.name: Polish Ministry of Finance and Economy

rounds.note_en: The PLN26.6m public support is attributable to Leonardo PZL-Swidnik under the signed agreement. The company's separate approximately PLN200m own-investment commitment is not external financing.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The company-specific public support is recorded in original currency.

sources.title: QinetiQ preliminary results report GBP150m gross primary IPO proceeds
UK National Audit Office confirms GBP150m of new money raised by QinetiQ

rounds.note_en: QinetiQ reported GBP150m gross proceeds and GBP132.7m net proceeds after IPO costs. Gross primary proceeds are retained as the round amount; government and Carlyle secondary sale proceeds are excluded.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The primary IPO financing is separated from shareholder divestments during privatisation.

sources.title: Qognifly announces closing its first EUR2m external financing round
Romanian report confirms the EUR2m first external financing

rounds.note_en: Qognifly described the investor only as a regional strategic partner in military infrastructure. No investor identity or unsupported role is invented.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The closed EUR2m round is recorded; the investor remains undisclosed.

sources.title: Swarmer SEC filing details the pending acquisition of 100% of Ratel Robotics
Swarmer announces definitive Ratel acquisition agreement for up to USD224m

rounds.note_en: The consideration is an up-to value comprising closing cash and shares plus contingent cash and share earnouts. It is a pending secondary acquisition of owners' participatory interests, not primary proceeds to Ratel; closing remains subject to conditions.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The signed ownership event is recorded with an up-to qualifier and explicit non-funding treatment.

sources.title: KIT case study reports Restube raised EUR600,000 from 640 investors via Seedmatch in 2016

rounds.note_en: KIT's company case study reports EUR600,000 raised from 640 crowd investors. Individual retail participants are not created as named investors.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The publicly documented 2016 crowdinvesting round is recorded; other financing requires event-level sources.
